title: K-pop makeup reference library
description: Save the whole look or individual face, eye, brow, cheek, and lip details. Style notes are editorial observations, and product suggestions are inspired alternatives.
rightsNote: Photos retain source credits and Creative Commons license links. The library is an editorial reference collection; image licenses do not establish artist endorsement, a model release, or permission to advertise products using an artist’s likeness.
regionMethod: Normalized 0–1 crop rectangles were set after visually inspecting each named source photograph. They select display areas and are not facial recognition or a diagnosis.
productLinkMethod: Region productIds and productCategories are style-inspired alternatives. productLinks with documented_campaign record separate official promotions and preserve product-family, shade, date, and personal-use limits.
referenceGroupMethod: Artist reference groups follow public biographies and official group descriptions, not appearance. They organize references only; every style and product can be explored by anyone.
styleMethod: Style IDs describe visible editorial qualities of a particular photograph, not an artist’s identity, exact products, or a verified skincare routine.

looks.title: Soft definition & natural texture
looks.summary: Visible skin texture, softly shaded eyes, and a muted lip give this airport portrait an understated feel. Light hair and a dark jacket create contrast without a high-shine makeup finish.

regions.title: Keep visible skin texture
regions.description: Small freckles and natural-looking texture remain visible. For an inspired base, use sheer coverage or spot concealer rather than covering every variation; the photo does not establish which base products were used.

regions.title: Soft neutral shading
regions.description: A muted brown impression around the lash line gives definition without a large graphic wing. Blend a small amount of neutral shadow and soften pencil along the outer lash line.

regions.title: Brushed brow structure
regions.description: The dark brows contrast with the light hair and retain a soft edge. Brush them into place, then add minimal color in the direction of the hairs.

regions.title: Restrained cheek definition
regions.description: The cheek area has a subdued warm impression and visible texture. If recreating the balance, use a light hand with blush or contour; the photograph does not verify either product was applied.

regions.title: Muted natural-looking lip
regions.description: The lip appears softly rose-toned with limited shine. Tap on a small amount of tint and diffuse the edge; a later official gloss promotion is recorded separately below.

looks.title: Soft rose gloss & delicate liner
looks.summary: A glossy rose lip and softly pink cheeks balance a fine upper lash line. Face-framing braids and a dark outfit keep the overall look playful and polished.

regions.title: Soft, even complexion
regions.description: The photographed complexion reads smooth with restrained shine. For a similar effect, apply a thin cushion layer and spot-conceal only where desired; choose a shade that matches your own skin.

regions.title: Fine extended upper line
regions.description: A narrow dark lash line and short outward extension frame the eyes. Try a fine pencil line with light mascara; keep the lid color softly neutral.

regions.title: Softly defined brows
regions.description: The visible brow sections look softly filled rather than sharply outlined. Brush in the direction of growth and add small strokes only in gaps.

regions.title: Diffused pink flush
regions.description: A pink flush sits across the upper cheeks. Blend a small amount of blush outward with a soft edge so it merges into the base.

regions.title: Glossy rose center
regions.description: The lips have a rose tone and visible reflected shine. Tap on a rose tint, soften the edge, and add clear gloss at the center for a related finish.
